name: atelier
description: insanetic's agent tooling for Claude Code: plugins, skills and mods shared across projects

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Prior art before you build: how others solved a task, what to reuse, the pitfalls, and how ours compares - every claim verified

plugins.name: market
plugins.description: Competitor tracking on top of research: the registry of every known competitor, discovery that keeps it complete, and the capability landscape

plugins.name: premortem
plugins.description: Premortem, dystopia and oppenheimer before costly or one-way calls: assume it failed, that it succeeded and did harm, or that the capability got out, then change the plan now

plugins.name: rulebook
plugins.description: A numbered convention catalog for coding agents: every rule one checkable entry with a stable ID, a deterministic check of the catalog, and a review of a change against the entries only review can judge

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: A personal brain: markdown notes in your home directory, reachable from every session only when asked, readable in Obsidian, with a lint that finds what went stale

plugins.name: data-max
plugins.description: Raw exports to warehouse, deterministically: profile and review a file, clean it with a declarative spec, check new exports for drift, and model the warehouse layers on top

plugins.name: paperwork
plugins.description: Invoices and receipts into an archive that never deletes: inbox, checked extraction, one naming convention per entity, year and direction, duplicates, CSV index
